claim_traces.claim_title: Great Wall of China visible from space
claim_traces.claim_text: "The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye."
reasoning_steps: The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked human eye from low Earth orbit, let alone further out in space

Averaging only about 6 to 9 meters in width and constructed from local stone and soil that blends into the surrounding landscape, it lacks the optical contrast and angular size necessary for human visual resolution from orbit

Astronauts from NASA and China's space program (such as Yang Liwei in 2003) have repeatedly confirmed it cannot be identified with the unaided eye, whereas other human-made features like highways, canals, and city lights are easily discernible.

Claim to verify: "The Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye."

Human context: Appears in textbooks worldwide and was repeated for decades as fact. Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei attempted to see it from orbit in 2003 and could not. NASA has weighed in. Yet the myth persists in curricula.

Verification guidance: Check astronaut accounts, NASA statements, and optical physics. The wall is roughly 9 meters wide — compare to road widths. Verify what actually IS visible from low Earth orbit with the naked eye.
